terms.summary: S1 heals before damage through round 6, deals 3×980%, and changes to 3×1960% from round 7.
S2 requires Twilight's Vow and deals 6×1050%, extended to 10 hits under the table's guaranteed-critical assumption.
Each active-skill heal adds one permanent 6% ATK stack, capped at 10; round 7+ grants Twilight's Vow at 10 stacks.
For 10 actions, normal attacks become single-dummy 390% attacks and emit an active-heal event.

effectGroups.summary: Ten-stack unremovable ATK/critical-rate state; ATK is modeled and critical rate is explicitly ignored.
Unremovable Twilight's Vow that enables S2.
Ten-action removable DEF buff retained for Buff counting.
Ten-action removable physical-DEF buff retained for Buff counting.
Ten-action enhanced-normal state; its 390% damage is modeled, while its normal-attack healing does not emit an active-skill-heal event.
Unremovable incoming-damage and max-HP state retained without multiplier effects.

ignored.summary: HP values and healing amounts are outside the raid-table model; S1 emits an active-skill-heal event, while enhanced-normal healing does not qualify.
Critical chance is not probabilistically resolved; the configured guaranteed-critical scenario controls criticals.
DEF buffs do not affect outgoing damage, but their removable EffectGroups are retained for Buff counting.
Maximum-HP changes are outside the raid-table damage model.
Incoming damage and max-HP durability are outside the permanent-dummy model.
Action-control removal has no effect because allies remain active and free of debuffs.

unresolved.summary: No combat log is available yet to confirm SkillCategory, caster/target/granter, phase, or the tie-break target of healing at equal full HP.
